# nullplatform_services (Data Source)

Lists the services visible at an NRN: those attached to it and to its ancestors, never those attached to its descendants. An application's NRN lists the application's services; a namespace's NRN does not.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nullplatform = {
      source = "nullplatform/nullplatform"
    }
  }
}

provider "nullplatform" {}

# The services visible at an application: its own and those of its ancestors
data "nullplatform_services" "app" {
  nrn = "organization=1234567890:account=987654321:namespace=1122334455:application=9876543210"
}

output "service_names" {
  value = [for service in data.nullplatform_services.app.services : service.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nrn` (String) The NRN to list services at, e.g. `organization=1:account=2:namespace=3:application=4`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (List of Object) The services visible at the NRN, ordered by creation time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
